name: Macfolio
description: A browser-based macOS desktop (PortfolioOS) that lets recruiters explore Kush's work like a real Mac — menu bar, Dock, Finder, Spotlight, windows, and apps including KushGPT, Activity Monitor, Messages, Notes, Terminal, and Settings. Built with Next.js, React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS, with Framer Motion window chrome, Zustand state, live GitHub telemetry, and a Postgres-backed assistant, analytics, and contact flow.

name: Potato Bazaar
description: Full-stack digital marketplace for real-time agricultural trading across web and mobile. Built scalable features for KYC, secure transactions, payments, logistics, and AI-powered crop insights. Integrated REST APIs, analytics, maps, weather, and third-party services. Engineered with React.js, Next.js, Node.js, and React Native for web, Android, and iOS.

name: Tybee Go
description: Developed scalable features for a tourism mobile application using React Native and TypeScript. Integrated RESTful APIs, pagination, and dynamic content rendering. Optimized performance through efficient state management, navigation, and asynchronous data handling. Built reusable modular components with clean architecture.

name: Findanio
description: Contributed to Findanio mobile and web apps at Protonshub Technologies, enhancing cross-platform UI and user experience for Android and iOS with Next.js, React.js, Node.js, MongoDB, and React Native.

name: Nexus
description: Peer-to-peer skill exchange platform enabling users to request and offer skills. Features include skill-based search, secure Auth0 authentication, collaboration sessions, and a user rating system — a scalable, community-driven learning product.
